# AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/generators/gen_tax_code.py — do not edit manually
# The legislated tax code's workbench handlers (plan Task 8; docs/systems/tax_code_schema.md,
# "Panels"). Hand-written ones (commands, the commencement stepper, display gates) are in
# te_tax_sguis.txt. Each handler's is_valid is a Task 6 trigger te_tax_can_<command> and its
# effect the matching te_tax_cmd_<command> with the same parameters, so a button's tooltip and
# its click cannot disagree. Country scope, rooted on the player; never the AI's.
#
# te_tax_step_<key>_sgui, one per instrument (INSTRUMENTS), op-coded by one saved scope:
#    0  te_tax_cmd_draft_step DIR = 0
#    1  te_tax_cmd_draft_step DIR = 1
#    2  te_tax_cmd_draft_step DIR = 2
#    3  te_tax_cmd_draft_step DIR = 3
#    4  te_tax_cmd_draft_step DIR = 4
#   10  te_tax_cmd_draft_sunset DIR = 0
#   11  te_tax_cmd_draft_sunset DIR = 1
# Every branch tests `exists = scope:op`; an unknown or missing op fails closed
# (trigger_else = { always = no }) and runs nothing.
# te_tax_good_<good>_sgui, one per catalog good: te_tax_cmd_draft_good.
# te_tax_relief_<key>_sgui, one per relief (agrel, regrel), op-coded like the step handlers:
#   op 0 one band less, 1 one band more, 2 none, 3 the deepest band, 4 out of the draft
#   (te_tax_cmd_draft_relief DIR = op).
# te_tax_customs_<good>_sgui, one per customs-catalog good (plan Task 15), op-coded:
#    0  te_tax_cmd_draft_customs D = imp DIR = 0
#    1  te_tax_cmd_draft_customs D = imp DIR = 1
#    2  te_tax_cmd_draft_customs D = imp DIR = 2
#   10  te_tax_cmd_draft_customs D = exp DIR = 0
#   11  te_tax_cmd_draft_customs D = exp DIR = 1
#   12  te_tax_cmd_draft_customs D = exp DIR = 2

	scope = country
	saved_scopes = { op }
	is_shown = { te_tax_code_in_force = yes }
	ai_is_valid = { always = no }

			limit = { exists = scope:op scope:op = 0 }

			limit = { exists = scope:op scope:op = 1 }

			limit = { exists = scope:op scope:op = 10 }

		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:op scope:op = 11 }

		trigger_else = { always = no }

		else_if = {

		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:op scope:op = 4 }

		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:op scope:op = 10 }

	is_shown = { te_tax_code_in_force = yes }
	ai_is_valid = { always = no }
	is_valid = { te_tax_can_draft_good = { GOOD = small_arms } }
	effect = { te_tax_cmd_draft_good = { GOOD = small_arms } }
}

te_tax_relief_agrel_sgui = {
	scope = country
	saved_scopes = { op }
	is_shown = { te_tax_code_in_force = yes }
	ai_is_valid = { always = no }
	is_valid = {
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:op scope:op = 0 }
			te_tax_can_draft_relief = { KEY = agrel DIR = 0 }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:op scope:op = 1 }
			te_tax_can_draft_relief = { KEY = agrel DIR = 1 }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:op scope:op = 2 }
			te_tax_can_draft_relief = { KEY = agrel DIR = 2 }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:op scope:op = 3 }
			te_tax_can_draft_relief = { KEY = agrel DIR = 3 }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:op scope:op = 4 }
			te_tax_can_draft_relief = { KEY = agrel DIR = 4 }
		}
		trigger_else = { always = no }
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:op scope:op = 0 }
			te_tax_cmd_draft_relief = { KEY = agrel DIR = 0 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:op scope:op = 1 }
			te_tax_cmd_draft_relief = { KEY = agrel DIR = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:op scope:op = 2 }
			te_tax_cmd_draft_relief = { KEY = agrel DIR = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:op scope:op = 3 }
			te_tax_cmd_draft_relief = { KEY = agrel DIR = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:op scope:op = 4 }
			te_tax_cmd_draft_relief = { KEY = agrel DIR = 4 }
		}
	}
}

	}
}
